description: Declarative registry for four top-level sk-design modes plus permanent interface-owned command subworkflows. The advisor routes one sk-design identity; the hub resolves a registered mode, while /interface:foundations and /interface:audit select typed subworkflows without creating additional mode or skill identities.

discriminator.workflowMode: Public hub/mode key. Stable identity used by the hub router and this registry. Carried by every mode.
discriminator.packetKind: The axis discriminator: 'workflow' for the three registered design-judgment modes (interface/motion/md-generator); 'transport' for the Open Design bridge.
discriminator.backendKind: Which backend runs the mode: reference-base (cites the shared design reference base under references/), playwright-extract (runs the embedded Playwright CSS-extraction pipeline), or od-cli-transport (drives the external Open Design app's od CLI and stdio MCP server).

advisorRoutingContract.routingClass: How the advisor finds the mode. For sk-design every mode is 'metadata' = resolved by hub membership; the advisor routes the single identity sk-design and the hub picks the mode, so no mode carries an advisor map entry or a merged-identity projection.
advisorRoutingContract.packetSkillName: The registered packet's SKILL.md name. Command subworkflows use contract.md and never declare packetSkillName.
advisorRoutingContract.grandfatheredFolderMismatch: true only when a registered packet folder differs from packetSkillName. All four registered modes use matching names.
advisorRoutingContract.command: The bound slash command for a registered mode, or null for a no-command transport. Commands owned by an internal interface subworkflow are declared only in commandSubworkflows.

transform-verbs.description: Declares the transform-verb routing extension: framing-split verb aliases (interface-frame 'make it' applies the move; audit-frame 'should it be' evaluates it), with excludedAliases and aliasOnly carve-outs. Activates the in-place top-level transformVerbRouting block without relocating it — the hub router vocabulary, command projection parity, and playbook scenarios all read it at that location.

command-subworkflows.description: Declares permanent public commands that execute complete workflows owned by one registered mode without adding peer mode or nested skill identities.

transport-axis.description: Declares the TRANSPORT axis. packetKind:'transport' entries bridge to an external tool's CLI/MCP surface (backendKind:'od-cli-transport', routingClass:'metadata', mutatesWorkspace:false since writes land in the external tool, not this repo). They never perform design judgment themselves — every entry on this axis has its own mandatory-pairing contract requiring sk-design's own workflow modes before any design-affecting operation.

transformVerbRouting.note: Transform verbs split by framing: audit asks whether the move should happen; interface applies the requested move. excludedAliases governs free-text transform-verb framing only (e.g. 'make it typeset'); command-metadata.json's taskProjections is a separate layer governing which mode owns the SAME verb under an explicit slash command (e.g. /interface:foundations typeset). The two intentionally name the same verbs for different resolution paths -- this is not a collision.

aliases: drive open design from the terminal
